findings.label: CONFIRMED_PRODUCT_PLUS_ONCHAIN_MARKET
findings.claim: Coinbase offers USDC loans against XRP through a Morpho/Base product; the cbXRP/USDC 62.5% LLTV market has $148.1M collateral, 118.59M cbXRP, $59.21M borrowed and 89.8% utilization in the 16:01 UTC snapshot.
findings.caveat: Specific market attribution is MorphoWatch's public-data inference; market is permissionless.

findings.label: CONFIRMED_COINBASE_ISSUER_DISCLOSURE
findings.claim: Coinbase reported 150.942M XRP reserves backing 150.940M cbXRP, approximately 1:1.

findings.label: DERIVED
findings.claim: Approximately 78.57% of cbXRP supply was posted in the primary cbXRP/USDC Morpho market in the same-day observations.
findings.caveat: Derived ratio; same-day provider snapshots, not a Coinbase customer-level position map.

findings.label: CONFIRMED_MARKET_COMPOSITION
findings.claim: Nine vaults supplied $58.19M of $65.92M USDC in the market; top three supplied about $52M. The market reported 1,122 liquidations and $3.94M debt repaid in the prior 30 days.

findings.label: INFERENCE
findings.claim: Circle-issued USDC is a debt asset used against XRP-backed collateral through Coinbase/Morpho, creating an indirect Circle-XRP credit connection.
findings.caveat: No evidence Circle directly supplies the market or that all USDC lender capital comes from Circle.

capital_distinctions.cbxrp_mint: Existing XRP wrapped against Coinbase custody; not proof of new spot purchase.
capital_distinctions.morpho_collateral: Existing XRP-backed cbXRP encumbered while debt is outstanding.
capital_distinctions.usdc_borrow: Credit liability; not net new capital and not necessarily spent on XRP.
capital_distinctions.usdc_lenders: Multiple vaults/curators; not attributed to Circle as direct lender.

next_actions: Track cbXRP reserve/supply and Morpho collateral daily with same timestamps.
Track vault allocations and withdrawals; identify concentration shifts.
Measure liquidation distance by borrower cohort without exposing identities.
Test whether released collateral is redeemed to native XRP or redeployed.
Keep Circle as USDC issuer distinct from actual vault suppliers.
